title: Special Locations
subtitle: Special locations mock test
description: A special locations exam covering BS 7671 Part 7 style questions on rooms containing baths or showers, medical locations, caravan parks, marinas, swimming pools, saunas and similar higher-risk installations.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements regarding special locations is false

options.A: No 13A socket outlets are allowed in rooms containing a bath
options.B: Socket outlets in a room containing a shower cubicle must be protected by a 30 mA rcd
options.C: Supplementary equipotential bonding may be required in a location containing a bath or shower
options.D: TN 230V a.c. circuits in medical locations must disconnect within 0.3 seconds

questions.explanation: BS 7671 Section 701 does not impose a blanket ban on 13 A socket outlets in rooms containing a bath or shower; they are permitted outside the zones, at the required distance and with RCD protection. The other statements are correct, so the false one is the absolute ban in option A.

questions.prompt: In a caravan the cross-sectional-area of every conductor shall be not less than
questions.explanation: Caravan wiring suffers constant vibration and flexing as the unit is towed and moved, so very thin conductors would be prone to fatigue and breakage. A 1.5mm² minimum gives the mechanical robustness needed for this mobile environment.

questions.prompt: Underground cables within marinas are considered to be at a sufficient minimum depth when at
questions.explanation: Around marinas the ground is constantly disturbed by mooring work, vehicles and water movement, so cables must sit deep enough to avoid being struck. A burial depth of 0.5m gives reasonable protection against routine mechanical damage in these areas.

questions.prompt: Wiring systems within the zones of a swimming pool should preferably be

options.B: Within conduits made of insulating material

questions.explanation: Section 702 swimming-pool zones increase shock risk because people are wet and often barefoot. Insulating conduit is preferred because it reduces exposed conductive parts in and around the zones.

questions.prompt: A.C. electrical inlets on caravans shall be installed above the ground at not more than
questions.explanation: The caravan inlet must be high enough to keep the connector and trailing lead clear of standing water and wheel splash, yet still within easy reach. Mounting it no more than 1.8m above ground meets both aims.

questions.prompt: Electric shaver supply units in zone 2 of a bathroom shall comply with
questions.explanation: Section 701 allows shaver supply units in bathroom zones only when they provide the required isolation. BS EN 61558-2-5 is the transformer standard for shaver supply units.

questions.prompt: Equipment within zone 3 of a sauna shall have a minimum withstand temperature of
questions.explanation: Air temperature in a sauna rises sharply with height, so equipment installed higher up must tolerate severe heat without degrading. Zone 3 fittings must withstand at least 125°C to remain safe at that level.

questions.prompt: Electric heating elements embedded in the floor of a bathroom it shall be

options.A: Buried to a depth not less than 25 mm
options.B: Covered by a earthed metallic grid or the heating cable shall have an earthed metallic sheath

questions.explanation: Section 701 requires embedded bathroom heating to have an earthed metallic grid or earthed metallic sheath. That gives a fault path and helps control touch voltage in a wet special location.

questions.prompt: Radiant heaters used in the vicinity of livestock should be placed, as a general rule, at a distance not less than
questions.explanation: Section 705 agricultural premises account for fire and injury risks around animals and bedding. Keeping radiant heaters at least 0.5 m from livestock reduces burn and ignition hazards.

questions.prompt: 13A BS 1363 socket outlets within rooms containing a shower cubicle shall be
questions.explanation: Keeping ordinary 13A socket-outlets at least 3.0m horizontally from the edge of Zone 1 ensures plugs, leads and appliances cannot be used while someone is in the shower, where wet skin and water dramatically lower body resistance and raise shock risk.

questions.prompt: Cables supplying electrical equipment in Zone 0 of a fountain shall be installed

options.A: As far as is reasonably practicable by the shortest route
options.B: Run inside Zone 0 by the longest route

questions.explanation: Section 702 treats fountain Zone 0 as the highest-risk water zone. Cable routes supplying Zone 0 equipment should be as short as reasonably practicable to minimise wiring exposed in the water zone.

questions.prompt: For connection to a caravan with a current rating of 25A the minimum csa of the cable shall be
questions.explanation: The flexible supply cable must safely carry the rated load without overheating; for a 25A caravan connection a 4.0mm² conductor provides adequate current-carrying capacity while remaining flexible enough for the trailing lead.

questions.prompt: Equipment installed in a sauna, where water jets may be present, shall have a minimum degree of protection of
questions.explanation: Section 703 requires higher ingress protection where water jets may be used in a sauna. IPX5 protects against water jets, which is why it is the minimum in that condition.

questions.prompt: The space under a bath is considered to be outside the Zones if

options.A: The equipment is protected by an rcd
options.B: The equipment is supplied by an SELV source
options.C: Access is only possible by means of a tool

questions.explanation: Under Section 701 zone definitions, the space under a bath is outside the zones only when it is not normally accessible. Requiring a tool for access makes it a restricted space rather than part of the bathroom zone.

questions.prompt: In conducting locations with restricted movement electrical separation is achieved when the number of items of equipment being connected to a secondary winding of an isolating transformer is limited to
questions.explanation: Section 706 conducting locations with restricted movement limit electrical separation to one item of equipment per transformer secondary. That avoids two separated items developing different fault potentials in a cramped conductive space.

questions.prompt: - In horticultural premises fire protection by using RCDs having a residual operating current not exceeding
questions.explanation: Section 705 uses RCDs for fire protection in agricultural and horticultural premises because dust, moisture and combustible material raise fire risk. The source limit for that fire-protection RCD is 300 mA.

questions.prompt: Means of isolation allowing for maintenance of a PV convertor shall be provided

options.D: On the A.C. and the D.C. side

questions.explanation: Section 712 PV systems can remain energised from both the array and the a.c. supply side. Isolation on both the d.c. and a.c. sides lets the converter be maintained safely.

questions.prompt: Zone 1 extends to a height above a swimming pool diving board of
questions.explanation: Section 702 extends swimming-pool Zone 1 around diving boards because wet users can reach equipment from the board area. The source vertical extent above the board is 2.5 m.

questions.prompt: In agricultural installations, electrical equipment for use under normal conditions shall have a degree of protection of at least
questions.explanation: Farm environments are wet, dusty and exposed to hose-down cleaning and animal contact, so enclosures need solid sealing. IP44 protects against objects over 1mm and splashing water, the minimum suited to these harsh everyday conditions.

questions.prompt: Where water jets are likely to be used in swimming pools for cleaning purposes, protection must be to at least
questions.explanation: Section 702 raises the ingress-protection requirement where water jets may be used for cleaning pools. IPX5 is the rating for protection against water jets.

questions.prompt: Electric vehicle charging points shall be equipped with one Type 3 socket-outlet for use with
questions.explanation: Mode 3 charging uses a dedicated EV supply circuit with control and protection built into the fixed installation, which is what a Type 3 socket-outlet is designed to serve. The dedicated socket ensures the charging system communicates and disconnects safely.

questions.prompt: On the d.c. side of a PV convertor, means of isolation shall be provided by a
questions.explanation: Section 712 requires reliable d.c. isolation for PV converters because PV strings can stay live whenever illuminated. A switch-disconnector provides mechanical isolation; a semiconductor device does not.

questions.prompt: In agricultural premises, self-supporting suspension cables shall be at a height of at least
questions.explanation: Overhead cables on a farm must clear tall machinery, trailers and stacked loads that move beneath them. A minimum height of 6.0m keeps self-supporting suspension cables safely above normal vehicle and equipment movement.

questions.prompt: Where SELV is used in conducting locations with restrictive movement basic protection shall be provided by

options.B: Basic insulation or barriers and enclosures
options.C: Class II insulation and placing out of reach

questions.explanation: Section 706 is stricter because movement is restricted and surroundings may be conductive. Even with SELV, basic protection must be by insulation or barriers/enclosures, not merely by placing parts out of reach.

questions.prompt: In camping parks socket-outlets shall be placed at a height above the ground of
questions.explanation: Section 708 caravan and camping parks keep socket outlets high enough to avoid ground water and impact, but low enough for practical connection. The source mounting range is 0.5 m to 1.5 m above ground.

questions.prompt: Socket-outlets in marinas shall be placed at a height above the highest water level of no less than
questions.explanation: Mounting socket-outlets at least 1.0m above the highest water level keeps them clear of wave splash, spray and tidal changes, protecting the live connections from water ingress at exposed berths.

questions.prompt: The nominal A.C. supply voltage of a temporary installation in an exhibition, show or stand shall not exceed:
questions.explanation: Exhibition and show installations are temporary and freely accessible to the public, so the supply is limited to reduce shock risk from a standard distribution system. Capping it at 230/400V a.c. or 500V d.c. keeps voltages to recognised safe levels.

questions.prompt: Each socket outlet in a caravan park shall have an IP rating of at least
questions.explanation: Section 708 caravan-park socket outlets are outdoors and exposed to weather and dust. IP44 is the minimum source rating for that environment.

questions.prompt: Where joints are made in cables within exhibition areas they may be in enclosures having a minimum degree of protection of
questions.explanation: Section 711 requires joints in exhibition-area cables to be enclosed so the public cannot touch live or damaged parts. IP4X gives protection against small-object access to hazardous parts.

questions.prompt: Which of the following protective measures against electric shock regarding ceiling heating systems is not permitted
questions.explanation: Section 753 heating systems do not use electrical separation as the protective measure for ceiling heating. The safer route is the specified shock protection for embedded heating systems, such as ADS with appropriate insulation, screening and RCD measures where required.

scoring.label: Strong — secure on special-location source questions
Pass — review the missed Part 7 requirements
Near miss — revise special-location zones and protective measures
Major gaps — rebuild Part 7 fundamentals first

priorities: Bath and shower zones, socket restrictions, RCD protection and IP requirements.
Swimming pools, saunas, medical locations, caravan parks and marinas.
Special-location disconnection, supplementary bonding and equipment selection.
Exceptions and exact wording in BS 7671 Part 7.
Read for the false or exception-based option; the source questions use close distractors.
